request.initial_prompt: Hamlet. Ay, lady, 'twas my word.— [To Polonius.] Thou wretched, rash, intruding fool, farewell! I took thee for thy better. Take thy fortune, Thou find'st to be too busy is some danger.— Leave wringing of your hands. raw_segments.text: Hamlet, Ay, lady, twas my word. To Polonius. Thou wretched, rash, intruding fool, farewell! I took thee for thy better. Take thy fortune, Thou find'st to be too busy is some danger. Leave wringing of your hands. Peace, sit you down, And let me wring your heart, for so I shall, If it be made of penetrable stuff, If damned custom have not braz'd it so, That it is proof and bulwark against sense.
